Environmental Engineering, Ph.D., Environmental Sustainability & Resilience Track
Degree requirements for the Ph.D. in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Sustainability & Resilience Track:
Ph.D. students must complete a total of 63 credit hours including: 24 to 36 hours of classroom graduate-level courses, 3 credit hours of graduate seminar (EVEN 6102), and 24 to 36 hours of research (EVEN 6306).
Students should successfully complete the Ph.D. Qualifying Exam.
Students should successfully defend the dissertation proposal and the final dissertation.
The required courses for the Ph.D. track in Environmental Sustainability and Resilience will consist of the following courses:
